question: A merchant sold an article at 20% loss. If he had sold it for Rs. 390 more, 6% would have been gained on the cost price. What is the cost price of the article?
solution:
Given:

A merchant sold an article at 20% loss. If he had sold it for Rs. 390 more, 6% would have been gained on the cost price.

Formula used:

Selling Price (Sp) = Cp + ((Profit)/(100)) × Cp

Cp = ((100)/(100space+space profitspace Percent)) × Sp

Calculation:

Let the Cost price be 100 units

A loss of 20 percent is 20 units

As per the question,

Value of 

⇒ 6 units - (-20) units = Rs 390

⇒ 26 units = Rs 390

⇒ 100 units = Rs 1500

Cost price is Rs 1500

∴ The correct option is 2
